entries.after:
import redis

# In 8.0.0, max_connections defaults to 100
client = redis.Redis(host='localhost', port=6379)
# Verify new default
assert client.connection_pool.max_connections == 100
entries.before:
import redis

# In 7.4.1, max_connections defaulted to 50
client = redis.Redis(host='localhost', port=6379)
# The connection pool should have max_connections != 100
assert client.connection_pool.max_connections != 100
entries.title: Connection pool max_connections default changed from 50 to 100

entries.after:
import redis

# In 8.0.0, socket_timeout defaults to 5 seconds
client = redis.Redis(host='localhost', port=6379)
# Verify new default
assert client.connection_pool.connection_kwargs.get('socket_timeout') == 5
entries.before:
import redis

# In 7.4.1, socket_timeout defaulted to None (no timeout)
client = redis.Redis(host='localhost', port=6379)
# Verify old default
assert client.connection_pool.connection_kwargs.get('socket_timeout') is None or client.connection_pool.connection_kwargs.get('socket_timeout') != 5
entries.title: Socket timeout defaults changed from None to 5 seconds, affecting blocking commands like BLPOP
